items.h: Handel and Haydn's Messiah at Symphony Hall, Nov. 27-29
items.sum: Harry Christophers leads the Handel and Haydn Society in its 173rd annual Messiah Nov. 27, 28 and 29 at Symphony Hall, Boston.

items.h: Thibaudet Plays Gershwin as Yamada Leads Respighi at Symphony Hall
items.sum: Friday, Nov. 27, at 1:30 p.m. and Saturday, Nov. 28, at 8:00 p.m. at Symphony Hall, 301 Massachusetts Ave., Back Bay.

items.h: Boston Ballet's 'Nutcracker' Returns to the Opera House Nov. 27
items.sum: Mikko Nissinen's holiday staple opens the day after Thanksgiving and runs through New Year's Eve.

items.h: Holiday Pops 2026: 41 Shows, Symphony Hall Dec. 3-28
items.sum: The Boston Pops' holiday season adds a Muppet movie night and a sensory-friendly concert; tickets are on sale now.

items.h: The Book of Esther in the Age of Rembrandt at the Gardner
items.sum: On view through January 18, 2027 in the Hostetter Gallery at the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum on the Fenway.

items.h: Picasso, Miró and Dalí Turn the Page at the MFA Through Jan. 24
items.sum: Through January 24, 2027, the MFA's Torf Gallery shows Spanish artists' illustrated books, with a virtual lecture on December 9 at 6:30 PM.

items.h: Sing We Noel: Christmas Music From England and Early America
items.sum: Sunday, December 6, at 6:30 PM at Gordon Chapel in Old South Church, Back Bay.

items.h: SoWa Christmas Market Opens Nov. 20 With 100-Plus Local Makers
items.sum: Opening night is Friday, November 20, from 4:00 to 9:00 PM at SoWa Power Station in the South End.

items.h: Huntington Premieres 'Adia & Clora Snatch Joy' Nov. 24 to Dec. 13
items.sum: The new play begins its run tonight and continues through Dec. 13 at the Huntington.

items.h: Places We Carry: SMFA at Tufts Juried Student Show Opens at the MFA
items.sum: Opens Saturday, Nov. 21, in the Edward H. Linde Gallery at the Museum of Fine Arts in Fenway and runs through April 18, 2027.

items.h: Unvarnished at the MFA: Conservators Restore a Dutch Group Portrait
items.sum: Opens Dec. 9 in the William A. Coolidge Gallery at the Museum of Fine Arts, 465 Huntington Avenue in the Fenway, and runs through Feb. 14, 2028.

items.h: Copley Square Lights Its Tree and Reopens the Park, Nov. 30
items.sum: The city's tree lighting runs 5:00 to 6:00 PM Monday, with arts and crafts, Santa and music from the Boston Children's Chorus.

items.h: Boston Tuba Christmas Brings Brass to The Steps Plaza, Nov. 28
items.sum: Saturday, November 28, from 12:30 to 1:30 PM at The Steps Plaza in Downtown Boston, with a festive tuba and brass program.

items.h: Boston's Long Weekend: Markets, Messiah and a Last Plymouth Call
items.sum: Snowport and SoWa close Thursday and stay open late Friday, Plimoth Patuxet's season ends Sunday, and Fabolous plays Encore Friday night.

items.h: Dinty Child and Mark Erelli Share Songs at Club Passim, Nov. 27
items.sum: Friday, Nov. 27, with doors at 6:00 PM and the show at 7:00 PM at Club Passim in Cambridge.
